The '''Junimo Catalogue''' is a catalogue of furniture and decor items that can be purchased at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Price|70000}} after completing either the [[Community Center]] [[Bundles]] or the [[Joja Community Development Form]]. There is a 10% chance the catalogue will appear in the shop's inventory.

Once placed, [[File:Right-Click.png|24px]] on the catalogue allows the player to obtain unlimited [[Junimos|Junimo]]-themed furniture and decor items at no cost.

'''Tip:''' {{Key|Shift}} + [[File:Left-Click.png|24px]] on an item to add it directly to inventory, instead of attaching it to the mouse cursor.
